input.summary: Insert a new Section 14 confirming Customer ownership of Customer Data and of deliverables created for Customer, with Kubient retaining the Auction Platform and licensing embedded Kubient IP.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no ownership article, so we have added one confirming that we retain all rights in our Content, Properties and data and that deliverables created for us are assigned to us, while Kubient keeps the Auction Platform and its background technology. Our fallback is Kubient ownership of its generic tools plus a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, sublicensable licence for us to use and modify deliverables.

ops.text: 14. Ownership of Deliverables and Customer Data. (a) Customer retains all right, title and interest, including all intellectual property rights, in and to the Content, the Properties, the Inventory, the Requests and all other data, materials and information provided or made available by or on behalf of Customer or collected from the Properties or their visitors (collectively, "Customer Data"). Kubient acquires no right, title or interest in the Customer Data and may use it solely to provide the Services during the Term. (b) Kubient retains all right, title and interest in the Auction Platform and its other pre-existing technology, tools and know-how, including any improvements thereto. (c) All deliverables, reports, analyses and other work product created by or on behalf of Kubient specifically for Customer under this Agreement (excluding Kubient's pre-existing materials) are the exclusive property of Customer, and Kubient hereby irrevocably assigns to Customer all right, title and interest therein. To the extent any Kubient pre-existing materials are embedded in or necessary to use such deliverables, Kubient grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid-up licence to use, modify and sublicense the same as part of such deliverables for Customer's business purposes. (d) Nothing in this Agreement creates any joint ownership of intellectual property. Sections following this Section 14 shall be renumbered accordingly.
